'''Jedder''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] living during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. He fought during the wars in the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. After the end of the war<ref name="Dynasty of Evil" /> in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he became a senior member and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Doan Royal Guard]].<ref name="Dynasty of Evil" /> In [[980 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] hired the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] female known as [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]] to [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|capture]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], as she believed the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] had [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Caleb|her father]]. Jedder was assigned to help the Huntress, however, he was killed during the attack.<ref name="Dynasty of Evil" />
